Perfect! All 347 tests pass. I've successfully implemented the `mergeCustomers` function with comprehensive test coverage.

## Summary

I added the `mergeCustomers` function to `src/customers.js` that:
- Takes `customers`, `invoices`, `fromId`, and `intoId` as parameters
- Normalizes both IDs using the existing `normalizeId` helper
- Returns errors for:
  - `SAME_CUSTOMER` if both IDs normalize to the same value
  - `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND` if either customer doesn't exist
- Removes the `fromId` customer from the customers array
- Updates all invoices belonging to `fromId` to belong to `intoId`
- Returns `ok({ customers, invoices })` with the updated arrays

I also:
- Added the `SAME_CUSTOMER` error code to `src/errors.js`
- Added 10 comprehensive tests to `test/customers.test.js` covering:
  - Basic merge functionality
  - ID normalization (whitespace and case handling)
  - Error cases (same customer, missing customers)
  - Immutability of original arrays
  - Edge cases (multiple invoices, empty arrays)

All 347 tests pass, including the 14 customer tests.
